answers.dataFlows: Contract records, originals, audit and attachments are stored in the buyer installation; enabled providers receive the data required by the authorized operation. Account location does not guarantee data residency: buyers must verify Cloudflare processing locations and configure and review every provider. Public exchange links expose the reviewed rendition and designated external comments to the bearer; reply addresses grant a separate inbound-only capability. Calendar connections store personal access tokens in the installation database and send agreement references, titles, deadline kinds, times and authenticated installation links. Cloudflare storage access and export custody remain buyer responsibilities.
answers.encryption: HTTPS protects provider transport. Cloudflare provides platform storage encryption. Operators must protect account access, local disks, private configuration and complete export archives. Application code does not claim customer-managed encryption keys or end-to-end encryption.
answers.access: Native owner and invited roles enforce current session, record, group and field access on server reads and guarded writes. Owner-created API tokens delegate explicit doors, expire within thirty days, and cease when the creator session ends. Owner-approved workforce SAML sign-in and SCIM provisioning create only non-owner accounts whose roles follow immutable owner-approved group mappings; managed deactivation or membership changes revoke their sessions immediately. Public exchange capability possession does not verify identity.
answers.audit: Native business commands, restricted reads, file downloads and exports retain attributed audit records. Public exchange activity identifies a designated contact by bearer possession; inbound sender addresses are not identity proof. Buyers must control database access and independent audit retention.
answers.backup: The owner runs rer export, protects the complete archive and tests rer import into an empty installation. Local archive integrity and restoration have automated portability evidence. A configured private UPDATE_ARCHIVES bucket holds same-account preupdate recovery archives; those archives exclude prior backup objects and include the current domain database and exact file bytes. The buyer owns archive access, retention, deletion, scheduling and recovery exercises. No automatic recurring backup schedule, geographical redundancy, recovery-time or recovery-point guarantee is claimed. Verify the installed runner version and its supported hosted recovery procedure.
answers.incident: Buyer operators revoke affected sessions, tokens and external exchanges, disable affected connectors, preserve audit and provider logs, assess exposure and arrange legally required notifications. Software vulnerabilities should be reported privately through repository security advisories.
answers.vulnerabilities: Release notes identify migrations and data-handling changes. The release-history command checks published release tags for gaps exceeding thirty-one days and published advisories against merged fix pull requests and fixed release publication within seven days. It fails closed when provenance is missing.
answers.responsibility: The software maintains application guards and migrations. The buyer owns Cloudflare account security, deployment, identity and connector configuration, consent, backups, monitoring, retention, incident response and procurement review. Connector contracts and processing terms are the buyer responsibility.
answers.assurance: Locket has no independent SOC 2 report, SIG certification or CAIQ certification. Cloudflare platform assurance does not certify this application. All 283 CAIQ 4.1.0 official question identifiers have software-scope responses and responsibility mappings; the copyrighted questionnaire text is not redistributed. The licensed 2026 SIG Lite workbook and its authoritative scoped question identifiers were not supplied. All 172 identifiers in a public 2019 workbook are mapped only for that historical copy; this is not a completed current SIG Lite questionnaire.
answers.governance: The repository documents application behavior and operating boundaries. It does not establish the buyer enterprise risk program, annual management review, legal register, audit program, exception process or risk acceptance. Buyer leadership must establish those controls and retain evidence.
answers.people: Locket does not operate the buyer workforce, perform background checks, administer employment agreements or deliver security training. The buyer manages personnel screening, confidentiality, acceptable use, remote work, asset return and training.
answers.physical: Cloudflare operates hosted facilities and underlying equipment; the buyer obtains and evaluates current provider evidence. Buyer-controlled offices, media, local machines and disaster planning remain buyer responsibilities. Locket supplies no facility access, environmental or hardware disposal assurance.
answers.endpoints: The buyer manages browsers, administrator machines and exported copies, including encryption, screen locks, inventory, patching, anti-malware, firewalls, device loss and remote wipe. The application has no endpoint management or native mobile app.
answers.change: The repository supplies versioned code, forward migrations, named acceptance journeys and automated checks. Buyer operators approve and deploy updates, separate environments and maintain recovery procedures. Forward migrations do not promise automatic rollback. Release-history tooling validates published evidence and does not itself establish historical compliance.
answers.privacy: Buyer counsel determines lawful purpose, disclosures, provider terms, retention, residency and subject-request handling. Native erasure, delegated privacy authority, legal holds and owner-confirmed draft disposition support that process; deletion is not a claim of forensic media sanitization, erasure from provider backups or jurisdiction-wide compliance.
answers.portability: The public API narrows reads by current authority; rer export and rer import provide complete portable installation archives with integrity validation and empty-destination requirements. Buyer custody, the supported runner transport and tested recovery procedures determine actual availability. No hosted service termination or data-return SLA is supplied.
